summary: In the third design meeting, the team finalized the physical styling, power source, and interface controls for the remote control. The team selected a single-curved form factor with colorful rubber material and corporate yellow and grey branding. Power will be supplied via standard batteries paired with solar cells. Interface controls will feature a side scroll-wheel integrated with buttons, while an LCD display was excluded to allow using a low-cost standard chip. Industrial Designer and User Interface Designer were tasked with completing the prototype drawing on the SMARTboard within thirty minutes.
decisions: Selected a single-curved casing design over flat or double-curved options
Chose soft-touch colorful rubber as the exterior casing material
Decided to incorporate corporate brand colors of grey and yellow into the design
Approved hybrid energy architecture combining standard batteries with solar cells
Integrated a side scroll-wheel with buttons for muting and volume control
Excluded an LCD display in order to utilize a standard low-cost microchip

action_items.task: Collaborate to produce the remote control prototype drawing on the SMARTboard
